crossRefs.note: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.
You know that I have served your father with all of my strength.
“These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven’t…
“Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due…
Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of…
Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men…
Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect: not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

translations.web: Jacob said to him, “You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.
translations.bsb: Then Jacob answered, “You know how I have served you and how your livestock have thrived under my care.
